versions.changelog: Groups can optionally match upcoming guide program names as well as channel names, with a configurable lookahead window (default 168 hours).
Initial release: keyword-based channel tagging, optional Collection sync, scheduled task, live auto-apply on channel add/update, and a small REST API for previewing matches and triggering a re-apply.

name: Live TV Channel Groups
description: Group Live TV channels by keyword (e.g. Hockey, NFL, News) as Tags and, optionally, Collections.
overview: Group Live TV channels by keyword
